description: Unit test for the FrameType class template in the core namespace, testing buffer manipulation, copying, and data reading functionalities.

classes.name: FrameType<BLOCKSIZE>
classes.description: A template class representing a frame or buffer with methods for setting and getting buffer segments, copying data, and reading various data types.

classes.name: FrameType<BLOCKSIZE>::Writer
classes.description: A nested class providing write access to a FrameType object, allowing buffer modification and data insertion.

classes.name: FrameType<BLOCKSIZE>::Reader
classes.description: A nested class providing read-only access to a FrameType object, enabling data extraction and validation.

methods.name: SetBuffer
methods.description: Sets a segment of the buffer with data from a provided array, returning the number of bytes written.

methods.name: GetBuffer
methods.description: Retrieves data from a buffer segment into a provided array, returning the number of bytes read.

methods.name: Size
methods.description: Sets or gets the size of the buffer.

methods.name: Clear
methods.description: Clears or resets the buffer to an initial state.

methods.name: Buffer
methods.description: Provides access to buffer data through writer and reader classes.

methods.name: Number
methods.description: Reads or writes numerical values of specified types.

methods.name: NullTerminatedText
methods.description: Reads or writes null-terminated text strings.
